description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_전국 우편번호(배달지 기준)별 택배물량 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 2023년 전국 우편번호별 우체국 택배물량 데이터 입니다 이 데이터는 2023년 1월부터 12월까지의 전국 우편번호(배달지 기준)별 택배물량을 월별로 집계한 공공데이터입니다. 각 우편번호 단위의 택배 도착 건수를 통해 지역별 물류 수요와 택배집중도를 분석할 수 있으며, 연간 총물량은 약 2억 9,000만... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 우편번호 기준 배달지, 월별 택배물량, 연간 총물량, 지역별 격차, 계절효과. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
